choice_data_list: What did you do on your day off?
What did you do on your day off?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I was just savoring the bliss
of doing nothing at all~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Just lying around, zoning out watching cat videos...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And next thing I knew, I was asleep...
Man, that was the best~.

It looks like Seiun Sky got some fulfilling rest
in her own unique way!
